title: NexVRGameProfile
description: Declarative VR configuration and engine profile for a game title in NexVR Engine.

id.description: Unique identifier: Steam App ID (e.g., '990080'), Epic catalog ID, or custom slug.

engine.description: Target game engine for projection math and shader compatibility.

reverseZ.description: Whether the engine uses reverse-Z depth buffer (1.0 = near, 0.0 = far).

rowMajorMatrices.description: Whether camera matrices are row-major (true for UE) or column-major (false for Unity).

motionAimSensitivity.description: Sensitivity multiplier for VR motion controller aiming.

useRecommendedResolution.description: Use headset recommended OpenXR swapchain resolution instead of desktop window size.

srgbCorrection.description: Apply sRGB gamma correction to prevent washed-out or double-gamma lighting.

depthSubmission.description: Submit reconstructed depth buffer to OpenXR runtime for positional timewarp.

rawInputMode.description: Bypass desktop cursor clipping and intercept raw mouse/gamepad deltas.

autoInjectOnLaunch.description: Automatically hook and inject when the game process is detected.
